target.cloud_rows: skill_source!='community' is not visible to these decisions

authority.route: mandatory get_current_user plus require_role(UserRole.TEAM_LEAD) on both routes
authority.service: re-reads the actor and checks active status and TEAM_LEAD+ role before effect
authority.scope: global/system community registry; audit attributed to the acting reviewer's real tenant/user

routes.effect: guarded UPDATE SkillExecution.status Untrusted -> Active plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.already_active: same-operation replay -> already_applied; new operation -> no_change/effect=none, no audit

routes.effect: guarded DELETE of the community SkillExecution row plus one AuditLog tombstone receipt

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id skill:<promote|delete>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw skill body, generated code, package list, scan payload, secret, SQL parameter or exception text is stored in the receipt or returned in logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session on the same engine; audit fields and the target state/material digest must match the original operation

result_states.verified: success shape plus additive verification/operation_id/audit_id; effect=committed
result_states.already_applied: same operation id and request material; one receipt/no second effect; replay=do_not_repeat
result_states.no_change: promote on already-Active with a new operation id; HTTP 200, effect=none, no new audit
result_states.not_applied: HTTP 409 confirmed local rollback; effect=none; SKILL_TRANSACTION_ROLLED_BACK
result_states.effect_unknown: HTTP 503; effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.routes: sole verified decision writers for community skill status/delete
parallel_writers.SkillRegistryService: promote_skill/delete_skill retained for internal/test callers; the routes no longer call them
parallel_writers.cloud_rows: unrelated execution records; invisible to these routes
parallel_writers.audit: existing AuditLog surface; additive safe receipt

not_covered: live code sandbox, Docker, model and provider operation
